description: Search live UK deals on ShopAt (prices in GBP). Filter by keyword, category, store, minimum discount or price, and sort by newest, hottest or biggest discount. Each result has the ShopAt deal page (url) and the tracked outbound link (go_url) that should be used when linking people to the retailer.

has_was_price.description: Only deals with both a current and a was price.
